edits.new:
Then the answer is 403 with MSG-P4-002 and nothing is returned

  Scenario: AC10 The record is append only, its final call is reference data and it carries no personal data or policy value (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given a decision record with decision code "D5" was recorded for treatment "T-1001"
    When the reader sends GET /api/recovery/decision/v1/decision-log/{entryId} for that record
    Then the final call is "SUGGESTION_RECORDED", read from its list of reference data and not a constant of the code
    Then the record has no update and no delete, and its previous hash equals the entry hash before it
    Then the record, the event and the log carry no personal data field, and this story reads no policy value of "TDR_OFFER"

  Scenario: AC11 The read answers 401 without authentication and 404 for an unknown entry (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the caller is not authenticated
    When the caller sends GET /api/recovery/decision/v1/decision-log/{entryId} for a record
    Then the answer is 401 and nothing is returned
    Given no decision record has the entry reference of the request
    When the reader sends GET /api/recovery/decision/v1/decision-log/{entryId} with that reference
    Then the answer is 404 and nothing is returned, and its message is Not specified in the source documents (NEWAC-RWB-P7-E2032-APP-AC11)

  Scenario: AC12 A change to a recorded entry that the model does not allow is refused (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given a decision record with decision code "D5" was recorded for treatment "T-1001"
    When a change to that record is sent as an update or a delete
    Then the change is refused, the record and the chain stand unchanged, and the refusal code is Not specified in the source documents (NEWAC-RWB-P7-E2032-APP-AC12)
    Then a correction is only a new record that names the record it corrects
